articles.title: Bud Cort, ‘Harold and Maude’ Star, Dies at 77
articles.summary: Acclaimed actor Bud Cort, known for personifying Harold in the 1971 cinematic classic "Harold and Maude," died in Connecticut at 77 after a long illness.
